title: Rank of normal functions and Betti strata
summary: In a recent work of the authors, we proved the generic positivity of the Beilinson-Bloch heights of the Gross-Schoen and Ceresa cycles. The geometric part of the proof was to prove the maximality of the rank of the associated normal function and the Zariski closedness of the Betti strata. In this paper, we generalize these geometric results to an arbitrary family of homologically trivial cycles.
